newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 13.35pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 13.35pct.

text.p: Yemen's Central Bank on Tuesday said its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average 13.35 percent, up from 12.83 percent at the June 22 auction.
Of the eight billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 5.88 billion rials.
The average price was 9,677.84 rials and the lowest accepted price was 9,620 rials. Yields ranged from 11.13 percent to 15.84 percent.
The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average of 12.84 percent from last month's average of 12.59 percent.
Of the three billion rials worth of 182-day bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 2.5 billion rials.
The average price was 9,398.32 rials and the lowest accepted price was 9,320 rials. Yields ranged from 7.02 percent to 14.63 percent.
The latest issue of 364-day bills yielded an average of 13.02 percent from last month's average of 13.19 percent.
Of the one billion rials worth of 364-day bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 970 million rials.
The average price was 8,850.61 rials and the lowest price accepted was 8,752 rials. Yields ranged from 11.45 percent to 14.30 percent.
